items.mainDefect: The client-side size limit is hard-coded to 10MB for every upload type, so attachments are no longer checked against max_attachment_size_kb.

secondary.defect: The file-too-large error messages, both here and in the 413 handler, show 10MB instead of the limit the server actually enforces.

items.mainDefect: Because maxSizeKB is hard-coded to 10MB for every type, attachments up to 10MB pass the client check even though the server still enforces max_attachment_size_kb.

secondary.defect: The translated file_too_large message shows max_size_kb 10240 instead of the limit the server actually enforces.
